title: Judge Gift Cards 2013: card flavor text

entities.name: Genesis
entities.description: A being said in the Scroll of Beginnings to have come first through the Riftstone, ending the world's lifelessness.

entities.name: Riftstone
entities.description: A passage through which Genesis was first to come, according to the Scroll of Beginnings.

entities.name: Scroll of Beginnings
entities.description: An in-world writing describing Genesis coming through the Riftstone.

entities.name: Cao Cao
entities.description: A commander who by the year 208 led more than 1,000 generals and a million troops.

entities.name: Sorin Markov
entities.description: An ancient being who claims to have seen entire civilizations rise and fall and views mortals as dust.

events.summary: According to the Scroll of Beginnings, Genesis was the first to come through the Riftstone, bringing life to the world.
events.quote: "First through the Riftstone was Genesis—and the world was lifeless no more."

events.summary: By the year 208, Cao Cao commanded a vast army of generals and troops.
events.quote: By the year 208, Cao Cao commanded more than 1,000 experienced generals and a million infantry, cavalry, and naval troops.

relations.note: The scroll records Genesis's coming through the Riftstone.
relations.quote: "First through the Riftstone was Genesis—and the world was lifeless no more." —*Scroll of Beginnings*
